Job Description
At our company, we build and scale technology that powers modern fintech businesses. We’re
looking for hands-on Backend Engineers who enjoy solving complex challenges,
building reliable systems, and continuously improving their technical expertise.
You’ll work on a multi-tenant fintech platform, contributing to both existing services
built with Ruby on Rails and the development of new backend solutions, with
Python/FastAPI as our primary technology direction for future development and
modernization.
Job Responsibilities:
• Maintain and enhance our existing Ruby on Rails CRM and fintech service
integrations, including payment gateways.
• Develop new backend services in Python using FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and
Alembic.
• Design and build REST APIs, authentication flows, background jobs, and
asynchronous/event-driven workflows.
• Work with PostgreSQL, Redis, and ClickHouse, including database migrations,
query optimization, and data consistency.
• Write reliable, maintainable, and testable backend code with proper error handling
and failure recovery.
• Troubleshoot production issues and collaborate with platform/DevOps engineers
in containerized deployment environments.
Job Requirements:
Must Haves:
• Strong proficiency in either Python or Ruby on Rails, with willingness to work
across both stacks.
• Solid understanding of backend application development and HTTP/REST APIs.
• Good understanding of relational databases and SQL, including transactions,
indexes, constraints, and data consistency.
• Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or a similar relational database.
• Experience using Git in a collaborative development environment.
• Experience working with Linux-based development environments.
• Experience with Docker and containerized applications.
• Experience writing unit and integration tests.
• Good problem-solving and debugging skills.
• Ability to understand and troubleshoot issues across application and database
layers.
Nice to Have
• Experience with Python async development and frameworks such as FastAPI,
SQLAlchemy, or Alembic.
• Production experience with Ruby on Rails and its ecosystem.
• Experience with Redis, background processing, Kafka, Pub/Sub, or other event-
driven systems.
• Understanding of concurrency, idempotency, retries, failure handling, and
distributed systems concepts.
• Familiarity with OAuth2/OIDC, ClickHouse, or other analytics databases.
• Familiarity with Kubernetes, Azure, ArgoCD, Helm, and CI/CD or GitOps
workflows.
• Familiarity with logs, metrics, and troubleshooting production systems.
• Experience with Vue.js / Nuxt / TypeScript is a plus.
• Interest or experience in fintech, payment systems, or digital financial services.
Desired soft skills
• Ability to learn technical and financial concepts quickly.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.
• Strong ownership and accountability for delivered work.
• Ability to troubleshoot production issues calmly and effectively.
• Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Willingness to learn new technologies and work across different backend stacks.
• Awareness of DevOps and Agile principles.
Qualifications:
• Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or
equivalent practical experience.
• 1+ years of relevant software engineering experience is preferred.
• Strong fresh graduates with solid backend fundamentals and demonstrable projects
are encouraged to apply.
